curve forward, left wheel 35 %, right 15 % (curves right)
drive forward at 30 % until the next movement

control_flow: followInTheDark (b4): if the right light is below 60 %, check the left light and the line tracker; else call avoidWalls (b23).
Inside the dark: if the left light is below 45 %, curve left 15/35 (b13); else if the line tracker reads more than 95 %, curve right 35/15 (b19); else call avoidWalls (b22).

avoidWalls (b24): if the left light is below 70 %, check the obstacle sensors on its sides: left seen, turn right 20° (b31); else right seen, turn left 20° (b35); else call driveInTheDark (b38); if the light is not below 70 %, call driveInTheDark (b39).
driveInTheDark (b40): if the left light is below 70 %, drive forward at 30 % (b45); else call stopAtWall (b47).
stopAtWall (b48): if an obstacle is ahead, stop (b51); else call followLine (b52).
followLine (b53): if the line tracker sees black, curve left 10/40 (b56); else curve right 40/10 (b59).

likely_intent.description: In the dark, follow a black line when one is under the robot and drive straight where there is none; in the light, follow the line as before.

decision_points.condition: the right light sensor reads below 60 % (it is in a tunnel, about 10 cm or more from an opening)

branches.outcome: dark: it goes on with the left light and the line tracker

decision_points.condition: first: the left light sensor reads below 45 % (deep in a tunnel); second: the line tracker reads more than 95 % (the white band beside the line)

branches.outcome: deep dark: it curves left at 15 % / 35 %
dim light and the line tracker reads more than 95 %: it curves right at 35 % / 15 %
dim light and the line tracker reads 95 % or less: it calls avoidWalls

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: dim: it checks the obstacle sensors on its sides

decision_points.condition: first: an obstacle is in front of its left half; second: an obstacle is in front of its right half

branches.outcome: an obstacle on its left: it turns right by 20°
no obstacle on its left, one on its right: it turns left by 20°
no obstacle on either side: it calls driveInTheDark

decision_points.condition: the left light sensor reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: dim or dark: it drives forward at 30 %
no obstacle ahead: it calls followLine
no black: it curves right at 40 % / 10 %

uncertainties: Deeper than about 13 cm into a tunnel the left light is below 45 %: there the program curves left whatever the line tracker sees, so in deep darkness it doesn't follow the line.
In the dark it only tells the white band (line tracker above 95 %) from everything else: on black and on a floor with no line it does the same, drives straight.
The 'dim light' part only lasts while the light is between about 45 % and 70 %, 7.5 to 13.75 cm from a tunnel's opening, so it is a narrow strip.
In the dark it never stops at a wall: the obstacle ahead is only checked in bright light.
The right light (below 60 %) and the left light (below 45 % and 70 %) are read at slightly different places, but in a tunnel they read nearly the same.
